# PI-MVP-002 — Intelligence and Agent Context

**Status:** Forecast  
**Forecast:** 2026-09-14 through 2026-10-11

## Objective

Turn the semantic kernel into useful local engineering intelligence: query, explanation, Work Packet context, CLI experience, determinism/security hardening, and measured performance.

## Work Cycles

- WC-MVP-0005 Query and explanation
- WC-MVP-0006 Work Packet/agent context
- WC-MVP-0007 CLI and developer experience
- WC-MVP-0008 Determinism, security, performance

## Included Work Packets

WP-MVP-0013 through WP-MVP-0023.

## Exit

M-002 MVP Beta demonstrates the central user journeys with bounded Codex context and trustworthy local behavior.
